descriptionHtml:
Candidate N13 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

A dictated discharge time does not reach the billing code: the Discharge summary drops it and the card asks the physician to pick the time instead of showing 99239

Tickets: TFA-92596 AC 5 (and TFA-92592: the Discharge template has no time section) · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: Dev 2 of 2 Hospital; Nursing Home intermittent (the D3 rerun coded 6 of 6).

Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S07 UAT step 2 in the app: a discharge with no time gets the one-tap '<= 30 / > 30 min' prompt and the choice survives a reload; a discharge whose dictation states the time keeps the time in the note and is coded from it wi …

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Discharge (Hospital 99238 / 99239, SNF 99315 / 99316): if the time is in the note, the code is set from it (<= 30 min -> 99238 / 99315, > 30 min -> 99239 / 99316); … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 5; TFA-92596 What (SNF discharge new family)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fixture Hospital patient and resident; the discharge template chosen by hand; each leg its own case with a fresh session

When h-no-time / n-no-time: Generate a Discharge summary / SNF discharge with no time -> Post-Round -> tap '> 30 min' (Hospital) or '<= 30 min' (Nursing Home) -> reload. h-time / h-over30 / n-time: Generate with the time in the dictation ('Total discharge time 40 minutes.' / 'Over 30 minutes spent on discharge.' / 'Total d …

Then No time: before the tap no discharge code is shown, only the prompt; after the tap 99239 / 99315, still there after reload. Time dictated: the note contains the time, the card shows 99239 / 99316 with no prompt and no MDM level

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint: prompt checkpoints mustContainAny both options and mustNotContain any discharge code, any other family and the no-result texts; after the tap mustContain the chosen code and not the other, billingCard exactlyOneCode + noReasoning + noLevelWords; after reload the same. …

Tickets: TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (ready for qa)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Dev 43c38a4f, live model, runs 17:46-18:17, 18:34-18:39 and 18:54-18:55 JST under runs/.dev.lock and the dev-session run lock; only 'QA TC18-BIL …' rows (and one 'QA TC18-BIL SNF discharge' template) were created and all were deleted, 0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows. Passed (2 legs): h-no-time (stock Discharge summary) and n-no-time (custom SNF Discharge type): before the tap 'CODE: none yet — select the time on discharge' with the two buttons; '> 30 min' -> 99239 / '≤ 30 min' -> 99315, labelled 'time selected by the physician', LEVEL —, still there after a reload. Failed (3 legs): h-time (dictated 'Total discharge time 40 minutes.') and h-over30 (dictated 'Over 30 minutes spent on discharge.'): the generated Discharge summary has no time anywhere (the stock template v1.1 lists Admission Date, Principal Diagnosis, Reason for Admission, Hospital Course, Discharge Condition, Discharge Medications, Follow-up, Return Precautions — no time), so billing, which reads only the final note, stores not_documented and asks for the time instead of 99239. n-time (dictated 'Total discharge time 40 minutes.', custom SNF Discharge template whose instructions ask for the time): the note kept it — 'TIME SPENT ON DISCHARGE / Forty minutes were spent on discharge planning and coordination.' — yet billing stored not_documented and showed the prompt instead of 99316. Follow-up D3 (18:54 JST): the same time sentence saved in six controlled notes — 'Forty minutes…' and '40 minutes…', with and without the 'TIME SPENT ON DISCHARGE' header, SNF and Hospital — was coded 99316 / 99239 every time with that sentence quoted, so the Nursing Home miss is intermittent or specific to that generated note (1 miss in 7 notes stating the time; the app does not store the model's raw answer). The Hospital failure is systematic: the stock Discharge template has no place for the dictated time.

Product issue: A physician who dictates the discharge time does not get the time-based code: in Hospital the Discharge summary drops the dictated '40 minutes' / 'over 30 minutes' (so the note also lacks the time 99239 needs) and the card asks '≤ 30 / > 30 min'; in Nursing Home the note says 'Forty minutes were spent on discharge planning and coordination.' and the card still asks for the time instead of showing 99316.

Evidence: 3 attached; 5 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/bil-1746/evidence/tc18-dev-s07-h-over30.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/bil-1746/evidence/tc18-dev-s07-h-no-time.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/bil-1834/evidence/tc18-dev-s07-n-time.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/bil-1834/evidence/tc18-dev-s07-n-no-time.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
